activation_baseline.basis: Ilyra Fen v677-v6 repository seal at the exact source; Ilyra's external canonical remains separate and Auren startup failures are retained below at zero credit.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first activation packet word-count expression over-escaped its token pattern and falsely returned zero.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: An explicit UTF-8 read with the corrected token expression counted 16,449 words and the exact packet SHA-256 was independently confirmed.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A PowerShell foreach expression was piped directly and failed with EmptyPipeElement before producing a source projection.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The rows were first materialized into a bounded array and only then projected, producing the attributable result.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined ancestry projection embedded native Git commands in a PowerShell expression and failed at parse time.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Each ancestry edge and exit code was captured as a scalar before projection; source, x1, evidence, and final direct-parent checks then matched.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first unbounded current-authentication JSON display was truncated and could not prove complete guidance coverage.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The same immutable file was reread in numbered bounded chunks through EOF without mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad D-drive filename search for Ilyra's canonical receipt exhausted its 30-second display bound without a usable path.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The search was narrowed to the declared receipt banks, locating the exact receipt and matching its activation SHA-256.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The shared current-auth and roster snapshots were structurally valid but stale at v667 and could not establish the live v677 edge.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The stale snapshots were retained as zero-credit drift evidence; the newer exact Ilyra activation and Hamish authority establish Auren v677-v7 and prospective Sable v677-v8 subject to terminal refresh.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first large activation display ended at its output limit and did not constitute an EOF read.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded UTF-8 chunks covered the missing region through EOF and were bound to the verified packet hash.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first owner-template copy attempted destinations before the empty sparse scripts and tests directories existed, so all three copies failed.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the missing Auren-owned directories were created; the three exact source templates were then copied successfully without sibling mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first x1 builder invocation found the pre-created empty owner phase directory and failed closed under its no-overwrite guard.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A read-only exact-target inspection proved the Auren v677-v7 directory had zero children; only that empty owner directory was removed before a fresh builder invocation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first complete source-bounded semantic audit found five exact-title collisions and fifteen rows at or above the 0.75 neighbor threshold, all retained with zero freeze credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the fifteen generic rows were rewritten as casefile-specific contracts before a new full source audit; the failed collision and quarantine result remains nonerasing Method Flow evidence.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first owner-test command used py -3, which resolved to a Microsoft Store Python 3.13 surface without pytest and failed before collection.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A bounded command-resolution probe selected the installed Python 3.12 runtime; python -B reported pytest 9.1.1 before the owner test was retried.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The legacy workspace-dependency loader returned that the app tool had moved to the Codex-app MCP server and supplied no runtime paths.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Local read-only command resolution identified the exact Python executable and pytest surface without installing packages or mutating profiles.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first Python 3.12 owner-test run occurred before exact staging and returned nine passes plus one manifest-coverage failure because the provisional manifest did not yet bind the three code and test paths.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact planning-only set was staged first, then the normalized-LF manifest assembler bound all staged owner paths before the owner test was rerun.
